name: What is a 1031 Exchange for Florida real estate investors?

mainEntity.name: What is a 1031 Exchange for Florida real estate investors?

acceptedAnswer.text: A 1031 Exchange, also known as a Like-Kind Exchange, allows real estate investors to defer capital gains taxes when selling an investment property and reinvesting the proceeds into a similar investment property. This tax-deferred exchange encourages reinvestment in real estate. To qualify, both the relinquished property and the replacement property must be held for productive use in a trade or business or for investment. A key process clarity point is that the sale proceeds must be held by a qualified intermediary and cannot touch the investor's bank account directly.
acceptedAnswer.description: A 1031 Exchange allows real estate investors to defer capital gains taxes when selling an investment property and reinvesting in a similar one, promoting reinvestment in Florida real estate.
